how.title: Three steps. Stop at any of them.
how.lead: Every deal in TermLift moves along the same ladder — you'll see it on your deal page exactly like this. And at any point, you can hand the negotiation to us.
how.s4body: At any point after Full Analysis, hand the deal over. A negotiator runs the back-and-forth, you approve the outcome. No savings, no fee.
